title: Memory register document
description: Two shapes in one file, because both are real: the front matter of `.ai/MEMORY.md` itself, and an inline entry block under a level-2 heading. `oneOf` keeps them apart — an entry's `category` is required and the document's is not, so one of the two branches always applies and never both. An entry does not repeat `title` or `type`: CONTEXT_SPEC 2.1 gives the title to the heading and the type to the `MEM-` prefix, because a second copy of either fact is a second thing that can be wrong.

iso-date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date. The pattern asserts the shape; whether the date is real is decided by the code.

memory-id.description: Numbered, and deliberately a different prefix from the document's own `MEMORY-001`, so an entry and the register are never the same ID.

category.description: What this entry is. There is no `decision`: a choice with alternatives and trade-offs is an ADR in `.ai/decisions/`, and a decision recorded only here would have no `superseded_by` for CTX-014 to follow.

scope.description: What the entry binds: `project`, `build`, `product`, or a subsystem name.

supersedes.description: The entry this one replaces. Null is a real value here and means nothing was replaced.
